name: landing
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a new V2 design for Korean personal meal and recipe service Salus. Primary request: MUCH LIGHTER, fresher, friendlier and less formal than a dark olive food editorial brand. Real polished consumer app screenshots with clear intentional typography and functional hierarchy. Use pure white #FFFFFF and very light cool neutral #F6F8F7 with fresh medium leaf green #51A86B accents, dark grey #303936 text, pale mint highlights. Entire image should feel breezy, everyday, easy, understated, premium through restraint. Modest 24-32px main headings, regular/medium Korean sans (Pretendard-like), small lowercase rounded sans "salus" wordmark with simple little leaf, never serif. No giant heavy black headlines, no full bleed editorial photography, no beige rustic table scenery, no dark olive buttons. Small appetizing real food photos only where they help choose a meal, maximum 20% of screen area. Simple line icons, abundant white space, comfortable 44-48px controls, 12px rounded corners where functional, very subtle thin borders, minimal shadow, no excessive pill/card nesting. One playful tiny line drawn vegetable accent is allowed but no mascots or cartoon crowds. No gradients, purple, sparkle/AI stars, glass, fake testimonials, metrics, guarantees or medical claims. All visible copy Korean except salus, Google and PLUS. Render highly legible Korean. Layout: landscape image 2400x1600, left approximately 76% main desktop screen, right 24% matching mobile responsive screen, thin light neutral gutter. Orthographic UI screenshot, no device hardware, no perspective, no presentation captions. Four independently generated screens share precisely this design system. This is a functioning-looking product design draft, not a marketing moodboard.
LANDING. Minimal header salus, 이용 방법, 요금 안내, 로그인, small green 시작하기. Main desktop hero is white and spacious, left aligned content in centered maxwidth layout. One small pale mint label "오늘의 식사 고민, 가볍게". Friendly moderate heading "오늘 뭐 먹지?\n같이 골라봐요." Subcopy "집에 있는 재료와 내 취향으로, 오늘 먹을 요리를 찾아요." Hero primary interaction a wide useful text entry "냉장고에 어떤 재료가 있나요?" with example typed "두부, 계란, 대파" and a simple green button "요리 찾기 →". Under entry three plain small suggested links "15분 요리" "가벼운 저녁" "재료 적게". Right hero modest airy cluster of TWO small functional recipe preview tiles with food photo only on upper half, dishes "두부 달걀 덮밥" "양배추 닭고기찜", time labels, no huge photography. Under hero heading "이렇게 시작하면 돼요" with three airy small horizontal line-icon steps "재료 알려주기" "요리 골라보기" "식사로 기록하기", descriptive single lines. Bottom section "오늘은 이런 요리 어때요?" with 3 compact wide landscape photo recipe tiles and plenty of whitespace, not enormous catalogue. Small footer 이용약관 개인정보처리방침. Mobile single column logo and menu, friendly heading, recipe search entry and button, 2 small recipe tiles, 3 steps; controls not cropped. Focus on a usable low-pressure first step. No health promises.
